en:
"CON-GRAT-U-LA-TIONS! You got all three, see!
Now you can go on to the second floor, yes!
You did it, see!"{w}{p}"Now then...
please continue to enjoy Joker Land, won't you..."{w}
note: Joker's lines end in katakana syllables (ne/yo/i) -- a sing-song clown lilt; rendered with the spelled-out CON-GRAT-U-LA-TIONS and tag words ('see', 'yes'). Second page matches row 857. [editorial] 'Hooray, hooray!' doubled a single yatta ne and lost 'you did it' (accuracy unc. 3); now 'You did it, see!' with the Joker's established ne -> 'see' tag (line 1).

en:
"Now then...
please continue to enjoy Joker Land, won't you..."{w}
note: Re-display of the second page of row 856; identical English.

en: Something is glittering on the ceiling.{w}
Something fell down.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Joker Medal.{w}
note: Item name: Joker Medal (jokaa medaru, ITEM_PRIZ 60-62). Row 855 calls it the 'Joker Land Medal' in speech.

en: There's nothing on the ceiling anymore.{w}
Something is written on the wall.{w}

{0E}*                               It's pitch dark!                               *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*   But take a gooood look around, why don't you?    *
*    The meda... Oops! Can't say any more than that!    *{0F}{w}
note: Wall sign framed with * and padded with spaces to about 365 px like other signs (wmap slice_06 row 444). {0E}..{0F} wraps a fresh banner here, not a re-display. Oops = established rendering of ookke/oootto (wmap slice_07 row 484).

en: There's something lying here.{w}
note: dupes 2: generic, works wherever an item lies on the floor.

en: Baby Orc
note: New name (ooku no akachan, hiragana). Gender unknown -- the baby is never given a pronoun in this slice.

en:
"WAAAAAAAAAAAH!
AH-AAAH-WAAAAAAAH!"{w}
note: Baby crying (ogyaa / uwaa).

en: Troll
note: dupes 7.

en:
"Would a pacifier get the kid to stop crying?{w}What am I s'posed to do...{w}It's not like they sell 'em in Joker Land..."{w}{p}"Oh, hey, you guys.{w}You wouldn't happen to have a pacifier... nah, guess not, huh."{w}{p}"All right! Here's what we'll do.{w}You're out collecting medals anyway, right?{w}So then..."{w}{p}"If you bring me a pacifier,
I'll open the door across the way for you.{w}How about it?"{w}{p}"I'm counting on you, all right?"{w}
note: 'the kid' avoids a pronoun for the baby. Last two pages identical to row 869.

en:
"If you bring me a pacifier,
I'll open the door across the way for you.{w}How about it?"{w}{p}"I'm counting on you, all right?"{w}
note: Re-display of the tail of row 868; identical English. yoroshiku tanomu ze = speaker asking the party: 'I'm counting on you'.

en: "Oh, you brought one!{w}You're a lifesaver!"{w}
"Heeere ya go, here's your pacifier!"{w}
note: Troll to the baby.

en: "Abu... abu..."{w}
note: Baby sucking/babbling sound.

en: "...Bawling one second, all smiles the next.{w}Knows what it wants, huh.{w}Well, I'm sure the parents'll turn up sooner or later."{w}{p}"The door, right?{w}There ya go, I'll open it for you!"{w}
note: Idiom naita karasu ga mou waratta (tears to smiles in no time); genkin na mon da = 'knows what it wants' (fickle/mercenary). 'it' refers to the baby -- gender unknown.

en: "What!?{w}You're just gonna leave a crying baby like that!?{w}What kind of heartless jerk are you!?!"{w}
note: Refusal branch. nante yatsu da at full force.

en: Souvenir Seller
note: New name (omiyageya-san). dupes 7.

en:
"Welcome, welcome!{w}You came all the way to Joker Land,
so be sure to grab a souvenir to remember it by!"{w}
Buy a Joker Land souvenir?
note: Menu prompt (186 px).

en: Joker Bun
note: New item: Joker manju (steamed bun) -> 'Joker Bun'.

en: Mud Pie
note: New key item (maddo pai; ITEM_PRIZ 46, used for the Branon event -- the sweets lover of wmap slice_10).

en: Don't buy

A Joker Bun is
300 GP, pal.{w}
note: Shop line with the seller's da ze; GP kept.

en: Who will eat it?
note: Character-select prompt; pattern of 'Who will pay?' (wmap slice_08 row 580).

en: {0A:0003:0000} ate the bun.{w}{p}
note: {0A:0003:0000} = chosen character name; ends {w}{p} as in source.

en:
"Well? Tasty, wasn't it?{w}Drop by again next time you're here, okay?
I'll be waiting!"{w}

"No money, huh? Can't be helped, then.{w}Drop by again next time you're here, okay?
I'll be waiting!"{w}
You threw it away on the sly so no one would see.{w}
note: Subject: the party (narration 'you'); likely the branch where no one is chosen to eat the bun. Seller's next line (887) doubts it was eaten.

en:
"Hm? Did you really eat it?{w}Eh, whatever. Drop by again next time you're here, okay?
I'll be waiting!"{w}

"Sorry, we're sold out right now.{w}Drop by again next time you're here, okay?
I'll be waiting!"{w}

A Mud Pie is
3,000 GP, pal.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Mud Pie.{w}

"Ooh, you've got a good eye, customer!{w}Those are real hard to come by, y'know?
Come see me again. I'll be waiting!"{w}
note: o-me ga takai = 'you've got a good eye'.

en:
"Drop by again next time you're here, okay?
I'll be waiting!"{w}

note: Sign, framed like row 863. eigyou jikan 19-ji yori = 'Office hours: from 7 PM' (the joke of an office opening at night kept).

en: "Hey, you!{w}This area's off-limits to anyone but staff!"{w}{p}"Oh, I get it! You still haven't had enough fun, have you?{w}What a troublesome customer!{w}But..."{w}{p}"In that case, allow me to show you somewhere special.{w}To a fun, fuuun little treat..."{w}{p}"Oops, a teleporter!{w}Aaand BOOM!"{w}
note: 'Oops, a teleporter!' = Wizardry trap-message parody (oootto, terepootaa da). hai doon = 'Aaand BOOM!', used consistently for every send-off in rows 894-902. otanoshimi = 'treat' (leads to scene 92016, row 919).

en: There's a sign here.{w}
{0E}*                                  Clown Alley                                  *{0F}{w}
note: New place: douke no komichi -> 'Clown Alley' (a real circus term for the clowns' backstage area; komichi = lane).

en: Hanger
note: New name, from MONSTER1/MON_TEXT: a ghost hanging upside down from the ceiling -- so 'Hanger', not 'Hunger'.

en:
"Waaaugh!
Don't just pop out at me like that!
Oh wait, I'm the one who popped out!"{w}{p}"So anyway, too bad for youuu!
No getting through heeere!{w}Aaand BOOM!"{w}
Gallery Knight
note: New name (MON_TEXT: a knight living inside a painting).

en: "Hey, you there.{w}Yeah, yeah, you guys."{w}{p}"This way, see. It's the wrong way. Wrong way.{w}Get it? Wrong way.{w}Road's blocked."{w}{p}"Gonna bust through me? Bust right through me?{w}Well, that'd be a problem.{w}Aaand BOOM!"{w}
note: hazure = losing pick / wrong route -> 'wrong way'; tousenbo = 'road's blocked'; kechirasu = 'bust through'.
Narration; troll as 'it' (monster, gender not given). Present tense kept as the scene is described in the moment.

en: "Aaand BOOM!"{w}
Outlandish clothes are strewn about.{w}
Outlandish clothes are strewn about.{w}You found something among them.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Beard Glasses.{w}
note: Beard Glasses = hige megane (nose-and-mustache novelty glasses), as already used in wmap slice_15 row 1155.

en: Goblin Magician
note: New name (goburin majishan); 'Magician' rather than glossary 'Mage' because it is a monster name, not the class. dupes 4.

en:
"Oh-ho?{w}So the theme of the new attraction is
destruction and entertainment, you say?"{w}
note: Goblin Magician speaks like an old man (ja nou) -- light 'you say' / 'I'd say' flavour.

en: Vampire
note: dupes 4.
Vampire is formal (sayou, de gozaimasu-style).

en: "Hmm.{w}And that is how you stoke fear and a sense of danger?{w}It wants one more twist, I'd say."{w}
"Then, how might coffins suit you?"{w}
"If you get put in a coffin... you lose?"{w}
note: Coffins = how dead party members are shown in the genre.

en: "Precisely."{w}
"Not bad at all..."{w}
"Heh heh heh heh..."{w}
"Rejected! REJECTED!"{w}
note: botsu da botsu = scrap the idea.

en: Both
note: Name box for the two planners together (futari).

en: "Whaaaaat!?!"{w}

Deep in the labyrinth, you met a bewitching foe.{w}Intoxicating beauty, a smile that could melt you.{w}A gaze so electrifying it captivates men and women alike.{w}{p}This is a trap!{w}Your heads know it, but you just can't help yourselves.{w}Surely there's nothing to be done about it.{w}
note: Scene 92016 OTANOSIMI (the 'treat' Joker promised in row 894). nayamashii = bewitching/alluring.

en: You felt a strange warmth on your arms.{w}
Something damp clung to your legs, too.{w}

As you went to look down at your feet,
it appeared before your eyes of its own accord.{w}
note: mukou kara = it came to you itself; the creature (Charmy Lip) not yet named, so 'it'.

en: Charmy Lip
note: New name (chaamii rippu; MON_TEXT: a pair of disembodied lips).

en: "Kyahaa~!"{w}
note: Source has a star symbol; replaced with ~ (ASCII only).

en:
There is a clown doll here.{w}{p}When you drew near,
the doll clattered up onto its feet.{w}
Clown Doll
note: New name (doukeshi no ningyou). dupes 7.

en: "Welcome to Joker Land!{w}Having fun? Sure you are!"{w}{p}"Anyway!{w}Today I've got a present for every one of you!"{w}{p}"Now, now, don't run off, don't mope!{w}I'll even let you pick!{w}Man, I'm just SO nice!!"{w}
note: omae ni mo sentakuken wa kurete yaru = 'I'll even let you pick'.

en: "C'mon, c'mon! Pick one! Ch-o-o-ose~?"
note: Menu prompt (268 px). e-ra-ve (silly drawn-out 'choose').

en: Sleepy Flash
note: Flash names: nemunemu/konran/buruburu/dokudoku -> Sleepy/Confusion/Shivery/Poison Flash. Slice_012 row 936 shouts the Poison one (dokudoku-u~ furaaaashu) -- should read e.g. 'Poiiison FLAAAASH!!'.

en: "Ain't no such thing."{w}
note: Katakana nai -> flat 'Ain't'.

en: Confusion Flash
"Whaaat? I can't heeear you?"{w}
Shivery Flash
note: buruburu = trembling with fear; the doll's reply (934) is about 'just scaring' you.

en: "Just scaring you? That's nowhere near enough, is it!?"{w}
Poison Flash
note: Correct pick -- slice_012 row 936 follows.

en:
"Gyahahahaha!
Now you're talkin', hey!"{w}{p}"Here it comes, here it comes -- Joker Land's famous specialty!{w}Poiiiison FLAAAAASH!!"{w}
note: Clown doll; the player just picked the poison option. 'dokudoku~ furaaaashu' is the stretched-out name of the menu choice in slice_011 row 935 (dokudoku flash); English assumes that choice reads 'Poison-Poison Flash' -- sync with slice_011. [accuracy] Shout now names the menu choice as rendered in row 935 ('Poison Flash'); the old 'Poison-poison' assumed a different menu label.

en:
"Gyahahaha!
Serves you right! Hee hee hee!!"{w}{p}"..........{w}Y'know what? I'm bored of playing with these guys.{w}...Guess I'll just kill 'em."{w}
note: Sudden mood drop is in the source (long silence, then 'korosu ka'); kept at full force.

en: There is an open space here.{w}
Use the Strange Box Garden?
note: Item name 'fushigi na hakoniwa' (key item, ITEM_PRIZ 62, max 18 chars): 'Strange Box Garden' = 18. 'fushigi na' -> 'Strange' as in wmap (Strange Bookmark, Strange Voice).

en: Dungeon Load data created successfully.{w}
note: System/op096 message. Read 'dungeon roodo' as 'load' (data being generated); could also be 'road'. Unverified in game.

en: Failed to create Dungeon Load data.{w}
note: See row 940.

en: There are marks where something used to be placed.{w}
note: Source writes 'ato' with the kanji for 'after' -- a typo for 'trace/mark'.

en: "Ah, Makakuri...{w}Look."{w}
note: Speaker box is '??' (row 943) -- it is Ruu, not yet introduced. Ruu's lines are written in odd katakana-mixed script (an unnatural, stilted voice); English renders this as plain, contraction-free, slightly stiff speech rather than mangled spelling.

en: Makakuri
note: New name (MON_TEXT 368: Hilde's demon follower, once a skeleton, now has a flesh body).

en: "Adventurers, huh... Your kind's never given me{w}a single good memory.{w}Get lost... And Ruu, don't bother with the likes of them."{w}
note: [accuracy] Glossary fixes ruu as 'Ruu' (was 'Lu').

en: Ruu
note: New name (small-u 'Ruu'); romanized 'Lu'. [accuracy] Glossary fixes ruu as 'Ruu' (was 'Lu').

en: "...Do you travel to many different places?"{w}
note: Ruu to the party.

en: "Hey, Ruu! We're going!"{w}
note: [accuracy] Glossary fixes ruu as 'Ruu' (was 'Lu').

en: "Okay..."{w}

note: Start of the second meeting.

en:
"...What do you lot want?{w}Like I told you before, you adventurers've never given me
a single good..."{w}
note: Trails off in the source; kept unfinished.

en: "...Hey, Ruu?"{w}
note: [accuracy] Glossary fixes ruu as 'Ruu' (was 'Lu').

en: "Are you searching for something too?"{w}
note: 'mo' = 'you too' -- Lu and Makakuri are also searching.

en: "Hey, Ruu!"{w}
note: [accuracy] Glossary fixes ruu as 'Ruu' (was 'Lu').

en: "But we cannot find it by ourselves.{w}We have searched for so long, and still we have not found it."{w}
note: 'it' = their sagashimono (what they are looking for); it turns out to be a girl (row 962), but Ruu has not said so yet.

en: "That doesn't mean we have to..."{w}
note: Cut off; Makakuri objects to asking adventurers for help.

en: "...Makakuri."{w}
"...Oh, fine, I get it already! Do what you want!{w}But if it comes down to it, I'm running, you hear!?"{w}
"But I know you will not run.{w}That is why I like you, Makakuri."{w}
"Shut up!"{w}
"If you find a short girl with blue hair,{w}please tell us.{w}We are looking for her."{w}
note: 'her' is safe: the source says onna no ko (girl).

en: "That's the deal! Got it?{w}...Jeez, why're we asking adventurers, of all people..."{w}
note: 'nandatte boukensha nanzo ni...' -- object of the sentence is implied (asking/relying on); restored as 'asking'.

en: "A short brat with blue hair!{w}Don't you forget it, got that!?"{w}
note: 'gaki' = brat; kept rude, which is what Lu objects to next.

en: "Makakuri, that is a rude way to say it."{w}
"Butt out!"{w}
note: 'hottoke' -- same English in row 976.

en:
You told them about the girl you had met
in the Crystal Labyrinth.{w}
note: 'Crystal Labyrinth' as in wmap slice_06 rows 468/470.

en: "The Crystal Labyrinth, huh..."{w}
"Thank you."{w}

"...I really don't get you adventurers."{w}{p}"Why would you go out of your way
to help the likes of us..."{w}
"Some people are good people, you know."{w}
note: Ruu answers row 970: some adventurers are good people.

en: "If you say so."{w}
"Then we will go now.{w}Thank you. Truly."{w}
"Be nice to the undead, y'hear!"{w}
note: 'fushizoku' = the undead (as a race). Makakuri was formerly a skeleton (MON_TEXT 368), hence the parting shot; Lu calls it rude again.

en: "Makakuri... like I said, that is a rude way to say it."{w}
note: 'dakara' = 'I told you' -- callback to row 965.

en: "Butt out!"{w}
note: Same as row 966.

en:
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}{p}But no one seems to have tended them lately.
The graves have been dug up and ransacked, and bones lie scattered about.{w}
note: Nameless graveyard of Rust Temple's quest (wmap slice_07 row 558).

en:
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}{p}But no one seems to have tended them lately.
Weeds have sprung up all around, and bones dug up from the graves lie scattered about.{w}{p}From somewhere comes the growl of wild dogs.{w}It seems they are the ones ransacking the graves.{w}
note: 'yaken' = wild dogs, as in wmap slice_07 row 558; plural kept to match row 979. 'kono koe no nushi' (the owner of this voice) -> 'they'.

en: You drove off the wild dogs that were ransacking the graves.{w}
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}Looking closely, you see small letters carved into them.{w}

note: Grave inscription in an asterisk frame (not an echo of the previous row). Full-width padding replaced by ASCII spaces; 3-line frame kept.

en: "What do you want?{w}Come to take back your goods?{w}Too bad. I already sold off the whole lot."{w}{p}"Huh? This book? Couldn't get a price for it.{w}Read it to kill time, and it turned out to be pretty good."{w}{p}"So that's how it is. Go on home.{w}There's nothin' left for you to take ba-- What? This book, you say?{w}...Sorry, but this one I ain't givin' back. Hey, boys!"{w}
note: Thief who robbed Lotz's cargo (EVENT_TEXT 33, ITEM_PRIZ 55 'Lotz event'). 'Omaera ga torikaesu mon nanka...' is cut off by 'nani?'; rendered as an interruption.

en: "I give! I'm sorry! I'll give it back, I'll give it back!{w}Don't get so worked up over a book nobody'd even pay for!"{w}{p}"...But hey, you're takin' it back to its owner, right?{w}Um... about me comin' by to borrow it... if that'd be okay...{w}I'm in no position to ask, but... put in a word for me, would ya?"{w}
note: Page 2 is identical to row 985; same English. 'Karini ittemo... moshi dekiru nara... tanondoite kure' = ask the owner whether he may come borrow the book.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Mujirod Manuscript.{w}
note: New name 'Mujid' (romanized). 'shahon' = hand-copied manuscript. 18 chars, fits ITEM_PRIZ 55 (max 18).

en: "...But hey, you're takin' it back to its owner, right?{w}Um... about me comin' by to borrow it... if that'd be okay...{w}I'm in no position to ask, but... put in a word for me, would ya?"{w}
note: Identical to row 983 page 2.

en: You passed on Lotz's message.{w}
note: New name 'Lotz' (romanized): old goblin who runs a magic shop in Lumisthenes (MON_TEXT 347).

en:
"Really!? Thanks a ton!{w}Never figured I'd actually be welcome..."{w}{p}"...Right. It ain't much of a thank-you, but
use this. I prob'ly won't need it anymore."{w}
note: 'kangei sareru' -- Lotz's message evidently welcomes him to come read/borrow the book.

en: "Well, so long. Thanks a lot."{w}

note: Floor Master encounter (Crotoa NE). Knight's gender unknown: 'the knight's' / 'its bearing' (bearing of a mindless figure).

en: Threading through the rubble of the city streets, a lone knight appeared.{w}
note: Crotoa SE Floor Master.

en: Dark Lord
note: Monster/class name 'daakuroodo' (MONRAW/MONSTER2).

en:
Neither side said a word.{w}{p}Of course, adventurers are free to offer a greeting.{w}Free to doubt, free to accept,
and free to draw their swords, too...{w}
Bishop
note: Glossary: shikyou = Bishop.

en:
"...Same line of work, huh? How's business on your end?
Us? Haha, can't complain, I guess."{w}
note: 'go-dougyou' = fellow adventurers; 'keiki' (business/fortunes) kept as the joke.

en: Fighter
note: 'senshi' as the Wizardry-style class name; no precedent in the corpus.
'fundari kettari' = one misfortune after another. [accuracy] sou demo nai daro contradicts the Bishop's 'mamaa' (so-so / can't complain); old 'not even that' was unclear.

en: "Don't say that. It might be worth somethin', y'know?"{w}

note: [editorial] 'No way in heck' was a minced oath not in the source and did not answer 997 ('might be worth somethin''); sonna wake aru ka -> 'Yeah, right!' ('hell' already used later in the row).
'daijoobu' in katakana = breezy 'A-OK'.

en: "Whoa, whoa."{w}
note: 'oioi' -- the Bishop protests the Fighter dumping it on strangers.
Source spells kurotowa here, kurotoa elsewhere (DGN_NAME, wmap slice_07 row 558); same place -> 'Crotoa City Ruins'.

en:
"Mind you, it only seems to work
in the Crotoa City Ruins."{w}

"Right, right, it's safe as long as you just carry it.
Here, take it!"{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Strange Box Garden.{w}
note: See row 939.

en:
"Put it back where it was in the Crotoa City Ruins
and you can go inside. As for the spot... ...Sorry, I forgot."{w}

note: Repeat-talk variant of row 1006.

en: *  Desert Wind  *{0F}{w}
note: op096 with a closing {0F} but no {0E}, as in the source. 'sabaku no kaze' -- probably a title/inscription; what it names is not clear from the script.
Centred framed text: full-width padding lines -> ASCII spaces / empty lines (3-line box kept). See row 1009.

en: A plant has taken root here, enduring the dryness of the desert.{w}

A plant has taken root here, enduring the dryness of the desert.{w}As you reach out to take it,
you hear a bird cry out from somewhere.{w}
note: Ties to the cactus/bird story in wmap slice_17 row 1358 (birds eat desert-plant flesh for their voices).

en: Take it?
Something swooped down from the sky and attacked you!{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Cactus Pulp.{w}
note: 'saboten no kaniku' -> 'Cactus Pulp' (wmap slice_17 row 1358 says 'the flesh of a plant'; 'pulp' reads better as an item name).
'kare (moshikuwa kanojo)' -- the narrator's deliberate he (or she) joke kept. Sentence spans a page break as in the source.

en:
The grotesque monster sank into the sand,
taking many mysteries with it.{w}
note: Follows row 1016 (slice_012): 'igyou no monsutaa' = grotesque monster; align with slice_012's wording if it differs.

en: Suddenly, a voice rang out.{w}
Voice
"Come forth, two of you."{w}
note: 'futari de maire': imperious order; read as 'only two may come' (party-size restriction?). 'two of you' keeps that reading without asserting the party is two people.

en: And then your bodies were hurled out of the room.{w}
Menolist
note: Spelling from slice_001 'Menolist's Candlestick'. One of the Great Demon Dukes (MON_TEXT 310): gentle, gentlemanly speech, candlestick head.

en:
"Ah, pardon me!{w}My name is Menolist!"{w}{p}"The truth is, I have lost my way!{w}Might I ask, incidentally -- Seirion-Daera...
that would be this Zefkaka here, would it not?"{w}
note: New names: Serion-Daera (dungeon; DGN_SET spells it the same, DGN_NAME/BGM_NAME have the variant Seirion=Daera) and Zefkaka (unknown; apparently what Menolist calls this place). Polite gentleman register per MON_TEXT.

en: "So you are the new apostles -- the Ryug?"
note: Yes/no prompt (data row) asked by Menolist ('anata-gata' = the party). 'atarashiki to' = new apostles/disciples; 'apostle' echoes the game subtitle. Ryug per wmap slice_20 (Fourth Generation people, MON_TEXT 321). 41 chars: if this box has the ~30 menu limit, short form: 'You're the new apostles, the Ryug?'.

en: A cactus came up close.{w}Its spines stuck right into you.{w}
*   Ouch, that hurts!!   *{w}
note: Centred banner; leading spaces mirror the source frame (style of the wmap banners).

en: Combat Teacher
note: 'bujutsu no sensei' = teacher of the Martial Arts Department; 'Martial Arts Teacher' (20) too long for a name box.

en:
"Show 'em the true grit of the Santorea Martial Arts Department!"{w}{p}"How far will your strength get you
against Professor Rombino?{w}Anyone who wants in, take your turns!"{w}
note: 'sokoiji' read as deep-down grit (not 'malice'). Rombino = monster 'great teacher' of the Martial Arts Tournament (MON_TEXT 285). 'sensei' -> Professor (name box: Prof.).

en: Will you take part?

"Your fighting spirit's way too weak!{w}Don't let Professor Rombino's adorable looks
overwhelm youuuu!!!"{w}
"By the way, the last champions were this bunch here!"{w}
note: The game presumably shows the previous winners right after.

en: "All right then, go on, one at a time!!{w}Get fired up, and... GO!"{w}
note: 'harikitte, go!' rendered the same in 1086.

en: "Whoa, that's amazing!{w}You won! The championship's yours!!"{w}
note: 'yours' left number-neutral: entrants go one at a time (1087 uses singular 'anata').

en: "Come back and play again, y'hear!"{w}

note: No pronoun for Rombino (gender not in glossary). The stick is probably the whistle these Professors hold in their mouths (MON_TEXT 284); kept vague as in the source.

en: Prof. Rombino

en: "Gyuuu."{w}

{0E}"I am none other than Mandelgius.{0F}
Monarch of beasts -- in other words! The BEAST LORD!"{w}{p}"I sense a power hidden within you all!{w}Yes, you have what it takes to become heroes!{w}
note: NEW TERM: Beast Lord (bi-suto ro-do, glossed in JP as monarch of beasts). shokun = "you all".
Highlight re-shows the second page of row 1101 verbatim.

en:
"Without further ado, I give you your first trial!{w}Go to the Blue Cave and catch the Azure Fish
that is said to live there!"{w}
note: Blue Cave (wmap slice_03), Azure Fish (chap slice_006 key item).

{0E}"I shall be right here, praying for your success!{0F}
Go! Go forth and cut loose!!"{w}
note: hajikete miro = burst out / let it all out; "cut loose" keeps his hot-blooded coach energy.

en: "Ohh, well done coming back!{w}You are everything I believed you to be!!"{w}
note: sasuga wagahai ga mikonda dake no koto wa aru = you live up to my high opinion of you.

en: "One Azure Fish, duly received.{w}Now then, if you'll excuse me."{w}
note: He excuses himself to eat it (next row).

en: Chomp! Munch munch...{w}
"Ohh, this is delicious! Too delicious!!{w}

{0E}"Ohh, this is delicious! Too delicious!!{0F}
Ngah! ...A bone... in my throat!"{w}
"Whew... that was close...{w}

{0E}"Whew... that was close...{0F}
But it was exquisite!{w}Now then, on to the second trial!"{w}

"Go to the deepest part of the Rinos Sea Volcano
and bring back the Proof of Endurance kept there!{w}And in its place, leave this Proof of Training!"{w}
note: NEW TERMS: Proof of Endurance (nintai no akashi), Proof of Training (tanren no akashi); ITEM_PRIZ 60-61 untranslated. Rinos Undersea Volcano per chap slice_006.

en:
[Key Item]
Received Proof of Training.{w}
note: Format per wmap slice_11 ("[Key Item] Received X.").

en: "By enduring the searing heat, you will temper body and spirit{w}and forge a spirit and body no great evil can defeat!!"{w}
note: Keeps the JP body/spirit - spirit/body chiasmus.

en:
"I can tell!{w}You have withstood that heat and pain, I see!!{w}That's my disciples for you!!"{w}{p}"The Proof of Training you left behind
is a baton passed on to the next heroes!{w}A hero must also take on the raising of the next generation!!"{w}

"Now, the third trial!{w}Go to Miasuna and teach a lesson to the Evil Magistrate
who sits enthroned in the innermost chamber!!"{w}
note: NEW NAME: Miasuna (MON_TEXT 301 gives kanji reading mi-a-su-na; matches the MIASUNA asset labels). akudaikan = the corrupt magistrate of samurai dramas -> "evil magistrate". Its boss is in the keep (EVENT_TEXT 53:8).

en: "That scoundrel has long done evil while hiding in the dark!{w}Behind every evil,{w}there is always a root of all evil pulling the strings!!{w}
note: yatsu = the magistrate; gender not established, so no pronoun ("That scoundrel"). JP row ends without a closing bracket; English mirrors it.

en: "Lurking in the shadows of the world of men, working evil,{w}{$09} you base and craven villain,{w}Mandelgius shall cut you down..."{w}
note: Parody of a samurai-drama hero's kill speech in 5-7-5 / 7-7 meter, ending on his own name. Rendered as a three-beat declamation ending on the name. {$09} kept after the {w} where the source has it (unknown code). akkan read as addressed to the villain (vocative).

en:
"What kind of hero lets evil run rampant
and just leaves it be!"{w}
"And so another great evil has been destroyed...{w}All thanks to your efforts.{w}I am overjoyed as well!!"{w}
"Now, the fourth trial!{w}You have no doubt noticed it yourselves."{w}
"Unleashed by the destruction of that great evil{w}-- another wicked aura..."{w}{p}"The fiend seized its chance and came back to life!{w}But its seal has not yet been fully broken!"{w}
note: hado = wave/aura of evil -> "wicked aura". yatsu = Tiger Centaur III (named next row); monster, gender not given, so "the fiend"/"its".

en:
"Now is the last chance
to seal the fiend away again!!"{w}{p}"Go to the Giaf Dunes{w}and do battle with Tiger Centaur III!!"{w}
note: NEW NAME: Tiger Centaur III (taiga-kentaurosu sansei; EL_KIRO/MONRAW 3-sei). Giaf Dunes per wmap slice_17. "our" chance: he is a party to the sealing. [accuracy] Source has no 'our' (ima ga ... saigo no chansu da); removed the added claim that Mandelgius shares the sealing.

en: "Ohh! Just what I'd expect from my disciples!!{w}There is no word for it but splendid!!"{w}
"To think you would endure every last one of my trials...{w}From this day forth, you may call yourselves heroes!!{w}
"But why did the seal come undone, I wonder...{w}Could someone have helped it along?{w}...I shall have to look into this myself."{w}
note: tebiki shita mono = someone who aided/guided (the release); kept indefinite.

en: "...Hm?{w}What's that you have there...???"{w}{p}"Gear handed down from your forebears, you say?{w}Ho ho.{w}...Ho hooooh!!"{w}
note: He switches from shokun to omae-tachi here; tone stays grand. sendai = previous generation/predecessor -> "forebears", matching the item names in rows 1136-1141.
genki wo chunyu = inject pep/vigor (comic); "pump full of vigor" keeps the gag.

note: Yes/no prompt. Agent left unnamed (Mandelgius's gender not established). 37 chars; JP is 19 full-width (~38 half-width).

"Here I go!{w}

en:
"Don't tell me you're one of Fena's trainees too?{w}Thought so."{w}{p}"Once you try it, you see
it's actually a good way to teach, in its own way.{w}...Not that the other teachers agree with me."{w}
note: Fena = Training Hall instructor (pilot row 193), so "trainees". hanashi ga awanai = can't see eye to eye.

en: Alchemy Teacher

"Alchemy is a backwater field of study, you see,{w}so it isn't a very popular class."{w}{p}"Even though once you can use it,
there's no spell more handy."{w}
Historian

"Welcome to the Santorea Academy Faculty Building.{w}I study neither magic nor martial arts,
but the history of this land."{w}{p}"Bu-ut, it's tough going.
You hardly ever find a kid who likes history,
so I really feel like I don't belong..."{w}
note: NEW TERM: Faculty Building (kyomu-to; DGN_NAME 31 untranslated, max 12 -> "Faculty Bldg" there). gakufu = Academy per chap slice_004. katami ga semai = feel squeezed out.

en:
"You're adventurers, right?
Will you be going to the Konnu Plains Ruins?"{w}{p}"Being ruins and all, that place has
lots of valuable things connected to ancient history
just lying there asleep."{w}{p}"So... just a quick look is fine.{w}Could I ask you to do some investigating?
Only if you get the chance to visit the ruins."{w}{p}"...Honestly, I'd like to go myself,
but school teachers have far less
free time than you'd think."{w}{p}"Just do it on the side, whenever.
I'm counting on you to survey those ruins."{w}
note: Konnu Plains per wmap slice_16; "Konnu Plains Ruins" for konnu sogen iseki. [editorial] 'things about ancient history' was unidiomatic; 'connected to' = ni kansuru.

en:
"Getting paid while doing research...
or so I thought, anyway.{w}Things never quite work out, do they?"{w}

You told the historian about the weathered
stone tablet you found at the Konnu Plains Ruins.{w}

en:
"Mm-hm, now that is interesting...{w}I see... I'll look into the rest myself.
Thanks for your help."{w}
Dragon Lord

"What are you doing? It's already night."{w}
"Hurry on home."

"Do you not understand when I tell you to go home!?!"{w}
"D-dismissal time...{w}was long... long past...{w}Even if it costs me my life, I WILL... send you home from school!!"{w}
note: gekou = going home after school; the gag is a dying monster as a school disciplinarian. kisama = hostile "you", carried by tone.
Mage's gender not established -> "the mage", "the robe". nitaa = creepy, leering grin.

"Lord Fulgrant's a mighty strong one, y'see,{w}an' does all sorts fer us as leader o' us ogres."{w}
note: Ogre speaks rural dialect (da de yo, kudasattoru wa) -> light folksy English. Fulgrant-sama: glossary gender unknown, so "Chief" (Fulgrant calls themself the ogres' and goblins' boss, row 1175) instead of the gendered "Lord" used for Balgert elsewhere.

en:
"Who are you lot?
Don't go barging into Lord Fulgrant's room uninvited."{w}
note: Chief = Fulgrant-sama, see row 1170.

en:
"Lord Fulgrant is asleep!
Come back another time!"{w}
Fulgrant

"Hey, you're the ones helpin' out with Balgert's plan, right?{w}Won'tcha hear out our idea too?"{w}{p}"...Huh, me? I'm Fulgrant!
I'm the boss of the ogres an' goblins.
So leave anything to do with Ogre Bay to me."{w}{p}"So anyway, here's the thing. We're thinkin' of buildin' a
huge custom cannon... an' givin' the Palace of the Sun
a big 'KA-BOOOOM!'"{w}{p}"Then we can knock the Palace of the Sun right outta the sky, right?{w}Once it comes down to the ground, we can pound
the Kin of Darkness flat, no sweat."{w}{p}"...See, good plan, right?{w}And yet the rest of 'em, they just..."{w}{p}"You lot'll help us out, won'tcha!
Let's build a cannon together!!"{w}
note: Rough, chummy speech (yo~, -tte n da) -> dropped g's. JP double brackets around doon -> single quotes. Kin of Darkness capitalised as in wmap slice_16 (wmap slice_20 used lower case). [editorial] Same quoted sound as 1185/1197, which use 'KA-BOOOOM!'; unified (as the 1185 note asked). [editorial] Fulgrant addresses the party as 'you lot' in every other row (same omaera); 'you guys' broke the voice.
sekkeizu rendered plural to match the key item "The Old Man's Blueprints" (chap slice_001).

en:
"Please! I'm beggin' you here!!
Find my old man's blueprints for me!!"{w}
note: kono tori da = "(bowing) like this" -> "I'm beggin' you here".

en: "Y-you got my old man's blueprints? ...Not yet, huh.{w}Aw, man, you got my hopes up for nothin'. Next time, come back once you've found 'em!!"{w}
You showed "Old Man's Plans" to Fulgrant.{w}
note: Item name as in pilot row 8; quotes kept from the source brackets.

en: "Wh... Whoa!!! This is..."{w}{p}"It's my old man's blueprints, the ones I lost! No doubt about it!!{w}You really went and found 'em for me..."{w}

"Amazin'... You actually found 'em!!{w}Right, with these, that cannon's gettin' finished for sure! ...So, uh, about that..."{w}{p}"To build a cannon, see... you need tools. You get that, right?{w}Well, I went and lost the cannon tools too."{w}{p}"I can't build it like this! You lot... go find me those tools!!"{w}{p}"It's all so we can get at the Palace of the Sun. If you could find the blueprints, the tools'll be a snap for you, right? I'm countin' on you!"{w}
"Haah, them cannon tools just ain't turnin' up anywhere...{w}What, you lot ain't found 'em yet either?"{w}{p}"We'll keep lookin' too, but you lot keep at it as well!!"{w}
You showed "Cannon Tools" to Fulgrant.{w}
"Wha... Is that...!?{w}Those are the cannon tools, ain't they!!! You did it, you lot! Knew you had it in ya..."{w}{p}"Now we can build the cannon! Just you wait, my dear Kin of Darkness..."{w}
note: 'kin of darkness' = [JP] as in wmap slice_20; the honorific [JP] is mock-polite, rendered 'my dear'.

en: "...So, anyway. I've been thinkin'.{w}Once the cannon's done, we fire it into the Palace of the Sun -- 'KA-BOOOOM!' -- right?"{w}{p}"And when that happens, just standin' around watchin' would be pretty boring, don'tcha think?"{w}
note: 'KA-BOOOOM!' for the quoted [JP]; same rendering in row 1197. Row 1175 (slice_014) has the same sound and should match.

en: "'Course you do! So what we're plannin' is, when we shoot down the Palace of the Sun, we all go 'WOOOOO!' and party it up!!"{w}{p}"And for that, we need bar snacks, right!{w}The plan is, everybody munches away while we whoop it up! And of course, the more folks watchin', the better!"{w}{p}"We'll invite a whole crowd... and then, if we watch it while munchin' on Seasoned Snacks..."{w}{p}"It's gonna be a blast, no question! You lot wanna eat some too, right?"{w}{p}"...Right, it's settled! We need Seasoned Snacks. I'm countin' on you! Go find some!"{w}
note: Item name 'Seasoned Bar Snacks' (pilot row 10) used as the noun, since the scene is the hunt for that key item. [proof] elided 'Course needs its apostrophe, as in 1207.

en: "So, find any Seasoned Snacks?{w}Hurry up and find 'em!! You wanna see the Palace of the Sun come down soon, don'tcha?"{w}

"Listen up, boys! It won't be long now...!
Let's show 'em what we're made of!!"{w}
note: [JP] = Fulgrant rallying his own ogre/goblin crew (not the party); 'boys' keeps the rough masculine [JP].

en: "...Oh? It's you lot."{w}
You showed "Seasoned Snacks" to Fulgrant.{w}

"Yeah, this is it...!!
Seasoned Snacks, the real deal!!!{w}You did great findin' 'em!!"{w}
"Alllright, we'll get right to work on the preparations!{w}Once you lot are ready too, come talk to me! It won't be long now!!"{w}

"Yo, here's how things stand on our end.
You lot ready?"{w}
note: [editorial] 'here's where we're at over here' doubled 'here'; reworded (kocchi wa konna kanji da).

en: "What, you ain't ready yet...?"{w}{p}"Well, there's still time. Get yourselves good and ready, then come talk to me again!"{w}

"We're all set over here.
Well then, let's go fire this thing!"{w}

"Right! Let's get straight to it... You lot!!!
Here we go -- 'KA-BOOOOM!'!!!"{w}
note: [JP]: could be his crew or the party; kept as an ambiguous 'You lot'.

en: "...Let 'er riiiiiiiip!!!"{w}
"Huh, that's weird...{w}Nothin's broken anywhere, right!?"{w}
note: Identical source to row 1202; same English. Cannon misfire branch (1200-1201).

en: "That's 'cause you handle it so rough, Lord Fulgrant~"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Lord Fulgrant' (cf. [JP] = 'Lord Void' in wmap slice_20). [accuracy] Fulgrant-sama -> 'Chief Fulgrant' as in rows 1170/1172/1173: glossary gender is unknown, so the gendered 'Lord' is avoided and the honorific is rendered consistently.

en: "Sorry 'bout this. Looks like the repairs are gonna take a while..."{w}
"Huh, that's weird...{w}Nothin's broken anywhere, right!?"{w}
note: Source has a stray full-width space before the final {w}; dropped. Same English as row 1199.

en: As if answering Fulgrant's voice, the ogres and goblins living in Ogre Bay gathered in one spot in no time at all.{w}
Goblin A
"Oh, so you came too, huh!"{w}
Goblin B
Ogre A

"Well? Ain't it a beauty?
I built that bit over there, y'know."{w}
Ogre B

"Like hell you did.
I built that!"{w}
note: [JP] ('don't talk rubbish') rendered as a colloquial contradiction.

en: Goblin C

"Oho, goin' at it, huh.
Bein' lively's fine, but keep that up and you'll miss the big moment when the cannon fires, y'know?"{w}

"Guess you got a point...
H-hey! It's about to start!"{w}
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!{w}A thunderous roar rang out all around, shaking the air.{w}
note: [JP] SFX; same rendering in row 1230.

en: The cannon scored a direct hit on the Palace of the Sun!{w}...It did, but the palace didn't budge an inch.{w}{p}Nothing was any different from before the cannon fired.{w}
note: [editorial] 'between before ... and now' was clumsy; same meaning.

en: "Wh... What!?{w}It didn't do a thing...?"{w}
After thinking for a moment, Fulgrant stared hard at you, as if struck by an idea.{w}You got a bad feeling about this.{w}
note: [editorial] Tense made past to match the surrounding scene narration (1216, 1220, 1233).

en:
Before you knew it, Fulgrant had grabbed you and forcibly crammed you into the cannon.
From inside the cannon, you could see the sky.{w}
All Goblins
"Threee!!"{w}
All Ogres
"Twooo!!"{w}
Everyone
"Ooone!!"{w}
"Fiiire~~!!"{w}
KA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!{w}

"How was it, you lot?
How'd it feel bein' a cannonball?"{w}

"You lot did good.
See? You made it back just fine, didn't ya!!"{w}{p}"Look, everybody's gathered here to catch a glimpse of you lot, y'know?"{w}
note: First page identical to row 1243.

en: Everyone appeared in the hall, and you received their praise.{w}

"So I hear you got shot all the way to the Palace of the Sun with that cannon?{w}That must've been rough, huh?"{w}{p}"Still, you did great!
Congratulations!"{w}

"Lord Fulgrant's cannon truly is in a league of its own, isn't it.{w}To think it reached all the way to the Palace of the Sun..."{w}{p}"Thank you for all your hard work.
And congratulations."{w}

usin' our brains is what it's all about."{w}
